reviews.evidence: Long northern tributary enters the western Morrison main arm upstream of the distinct southwestern tributary; coast and neighboring Pathend/McLeod drainage confirm wider identity. Crosshair lies at native junction; short extra western native spur is not separately represented in modern reference.
Historical brook terminates directly at coast; modern looping and branching coastal water differs. Do not add a coast control on this uncertain channel.
